The rectangle is the classic shape for portrait photos. Your image sculpted into a precise three-dimensional model, engraved inside a block of optical crystal glass with a 4K laser, and hand-polished before it ships. The 3D Memory Crystal™ rectangle handles full-face portraits, vertical compositions, and photos with two or more faces with the sharpest detail in the collection. Engraved inside the crystal where nothing fades, peels, or scratches. Every Beyond Memories® rectangle crystal starts with your image. Our design team reviews and enhances the photo for laser clarity. Our artists set the 3D engraving model. A 4K laser fires millions of microscopic points inside the crystal, building your photo one layer at a time from the inside out. The finished crystal is hand-polished, inspected, and packaged in a gift-ready box. Real artists, not algorithms. 100% K9 optical crystal - lifetime clarity, scratch-resistant 4K laser engraving - millions of points etched inside the crystal Expert photo enhancement included - our design team improves every image Available in five sizes: Small, Medium, Large, XL, Max Standard or 4K HD engraving - choose at checkout LED light base available - illuminates the engraving for display Premium gift-ready box included at no extra charge U.S.-based support team - real humans, not a chatbot Ships via UPS, USPS, or FedEx - tracking included A 3D crystal photo frame, in the rectangle shape, is the classic portrait keepsake - a vertical block of optical crystal glass with your photo engraved inside, not behind a pane of glass. Unlike a traditional picture frame where the photo sits on paper that fades and yellows over time, the rectangle 3D crystal preserves the image inside the crystal itself with lifelike depth and brilliant clarity. The shape is the most versatile in the collection: it handles a single portrait, a couple, or a small group equally well. The rectangle works best with photos taken in vertical (portrait) orientation, with the subject's face filling a comfortable portion of the frame. Full-face portraits, wedding photos, baby photos, family portraits with two or three faces, and travel photos with one or two people in the foreground all engrave with sharp detail. Wide group shots and landscape orientations are better suited to the heart shape for romantic close-ups or a cube shape for 360° viewing of group photos. What sizes are available for the rectangle crystal? The rectangle 3D Memory Crystal comes in five sizes: Small, Medium, Large, XL, and Max. Size guidance: a single face engraves well at any size; two faces work best from Medium and up; group portraits with three or more people should be Large or larger. The exact dimensions are listed in the size selector. Does the rectangle work in vertical and horizontal orientation? The rectangle is optimized for vertical (portrait) orientation, which suits most portrait photos. Horizontal landscape compositions can be engraved but the engraving area is shorter - for landscape orientations or wide group shots, the cube shape (visible on four faces simultaneously) is often a better fit. What's the difference between Standard and 4K HD engraving? Standard engraving produces a sharp, clear 3D image suitable for most photos. The 4K HD upgrade increases the resolution of the laser engraving - about 50% more dots - adding finer detail and smoother gradients. For close-up viewing or photos with intricate facial detail, 4K HD is recommended. Both use the same 100% K9 optical crystal and the same hand-polish process. How many people can I fit in a rectangle crystal? One face engraves beautifully in any size. Two faces work best at Medium and up. Three or more faces should choose Large, XL, or Max - the larger sizes give each face enough engraving area to retain sharp detail. Our design team reviews every photo before production and will contact you if your image needs adjustment for the chosen size. What photo works best for a rectangle crystal? A clear, well-lit photo in vertical orientation with the subject's face occupying a prominent portion of the frame produces the sharpest engraving. Photos shot in good natural light from a recent phone or camera generally have enough resolution. Older or lower-resolution photos can often be enhanced - send what you have and we'll tell you what's possible. How long does production take? Standard production is 1-2 business days after your order. Express shipping options are available at checkout for time-sensitive gifts. Orders placed before 9 AM PT begin production the same business day. U.S. shipping is 3-5 business days via UPS, USPS, or FedEx. International shipping via UPS, USPS, FedEx, or DHL depending on the destination, with rates calculated at checkout.
